points.description: States that in a flat region there is no change in intensity in any direction, and on an edge there is no change along the edge direction (change only across/perpendicular to it).
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of flat region or edge is correctly described, or both are stated vaguely.

points.description: States that at a corner there is significant change in all directions, so the detector relies on direction-dependent intensity change to identify corners (distinguishing them from edges and flat regions).
points.partial_credit: Half if corner is said to have change but 'all directions' or significance is missing or vague.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both ideas: flat/edge behaviour (no change in all directions / along the edge) and corner behaviour (significant change in all directions). Different wording is fine. Give part marks for vague or half-stated ideas; a mention of affine dependence on direction is not required. Give no marks for wrong or unrelated answers.
